title: Abalaleli Abafihliwe Ababekholwa
intro: Ngesikhathi sokuthula kombuthano ongcwele, kwafika umhlangano omangalisayo uvela endaweni engabonakali. Bedonswa yizindlebe zokuthize okumangalisayo, balalela ukulandisa okwakuzoqinisekisa isiphetho sabo kuze kube phakade. Ubufakazi babo buhlala bungobunye bobuyingqayizivele kakhulu emibhalweni engcwele.
clues: Singabantu abavela endaweni engabonakali ngabaningi, futhi seza njengeqembu.
Saya embuthanweni ukuze sizwe okuthile okumangalisayo.
Lapho sifika, salalela ingoma eyasishiya simangele.
Savuma obala ukuthi abanye phakathi kwethu balungile kanti abanye abalungile.
Sasazi ukuthi asinakubalekela isinqumo sikaNkulunkulu emhlabeni, noma ngokubalekela esibhakabhakeni.
Lapho sizwa isiqondiso, sakholwa kuso; noma ngubani okholwa eNkosini yakhe ngeke esabe ukulahlekelwa noma umthwalo.
arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
